findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_uwear_library, modify_shoot_board, mcp_brief_runs, get_generation_results, upload_garment_from_public_url, queue_generation_result_qa, read_generation_result_qa, mcp_read_generation_result · Private data: read_shoot_board, search_uwear_library, add_chat_photos_to_board, upload_garment_from_public_url, upload_avatar_from_chat_file, create_tag, list_tags, save_reference_file_from_chat_file, list_art_directions, mcp_list_files, mcp_intake_files, mcp_commit_intake, mcp_upload_intake_photo · Public sink: modify_shoot_board, update_automation, upload_garment_from_public_url, upload_avatar_from_chat_file, list_templates, mcp_intake_files, mcp_upload_intake_photo, mcp_extract_video_frame, uwear_settings_update · Destructive: modify_shoot_board, set_garment_side, plan_shoot_image, plan_shoot_edit, plan_shoot_camera_change, plan_shoot_upscale, plan_shoot_background_removal, plan_shoot_video, remove_shoot_image, remove_shoot_step, save_automation, propose_brief, confirm_brief, list_briefs, mcp_brief_runs, queue_generation_result_qa, update_montage_proposal, list_templates, mcp_intake_files, mcp_add_garment_view, mcp_edit_brief, mcp_recipe_history, mcp_workflow_contract, mcp_delete_generation_results.
